桥中间: in the middle of the bridge
给这段桥面的中点加一根斜撑，或从上方用钢索 / 吊杆拉住它: Add a diagonal brace at the middle of this deck span, or hold it from above with a cable / hanger
这根构件主要在受弯：加斜杆组成三角形，让它主要承受拉压: This member mainly bends: add diagonals to form triangles so it mostly carries tension and compression
把它换成钢梁或钢索，或把桁架加高以减小拉力: Replace it with a steel beam or cable, or make the truss taller to reduce the tension
缩短这根受压杆：在它中间加一个节点并连一根斜撑，或改用钢梁: Shorten this compression member: add a node in its middle and connect a brace, or use a steel beam
给这里的节点再连一根不同方向的构件，组成三角形: Connect another member in a different direction to this node to form a triangle
把桥面一直铺到右岸的“终点”锚点，中间不要留断口: Lay the deck all the way to the “end” anchor on the right bank without gaps
铁路桥要更刚：加高桁架、加密桥面下的支点，减小列车经过时铁轨的下沉与起伏: Rail bridges must be stiffer: make the truss taller and add supports under the deck to reduce rail sag and bounce as the train passes
火车走铁轨桥面，汽车走公路桥面；两种都要过就用铁轨公路复合桥面: Trains use rail decks and cars use road decks; if both must cross, use the rail + road deck
检查桥面是否连续、坡度是否过大: Check that the deck is continuous and not too steep
把航道（橙色框）里的构件移走或抬高到船高以上，或改用液压杆让路: Move the members out of the ship channel (orange box) or raise them above the ship height, or use hydraulics to make way
桥墩下的地基承受不住，基础失效了: The ground under the pier could not carry it; the foundation failed
软土上的桥墩改用桩基础，或把桥墩建在岩石区: Use pile foundations for piers on soft soil, or build the piers on rock
一个锚点承受不住，被拉脱了: An anchor could not hold and was pulled out
把载荷分给更多锚点，或减轻桥的自重: Spread the load over more anchors, or reduce the bridge's self-weight
冲刷区的桥墩改用桩基础或移到岩石区；洪水关不要用木桥墩: Use pile foundations for piers in the scour zone or move them to rock; don't use timber piers in the flood level
加高桁架或增加支点，提高桥的刚度: Make the truss taller or add supports to stiffen the bridge
先加强最先断裂的那根构件，并增加冗余斜撑: Strengthen the member that broke first and add redundant braces
道路没有连接两岸: The road does not connect the two banks
构件超过抗拉强度（拉伸破坏）: A member exceeded its tensile strength (tension failure)
构件超过抗压强度或发生屈曲（压缩破坏）: A member exceeded its compressive strength or buckled (compression failure)
构件抗弯不足（弯曲破坏）: A member is not strong enough in bending (bending failure)
船只撞上桥梁（净空不足）: A ship hit the bridge (not enough clearance)
洪水冲毁桥墩或掏空基础: The flood destroyed a pier or scoured out its foundation
列车脱轨（铁轨上下晃动太大）: Train derailed (the rails moved up and down too much)
车辆驶上了不能通行的路面: A vehicle drove onto a surface it cannot use
使用“道路桥面”工具从左岸道路锚点连续铺设到右岸道路锚点: Use the road deck tool to lay deck continuously from the left road anchor to the right road anchor
桥面段必须首尾相接且自左向右前进: Deck segments must join end to end and go from left to right
把受拉构件换成钢梁或钢索: Replace members in tension with steel beams or cables
增加桁架高度以降低弦杆拉力: Make the truss taller to reduce the chord tension
增加斜杆分担载荷: Add diagonals to share the load
缩短受压构件（长杆容易屈曲）: Shorten compression members (long bars buckle easily)
受压构件改用钢梁: Use steel beams for compression members
增加节点把长压杆分段: Add nodes to split long compression members
构件以受弯为主时承载力很低：用斜杆组成三角形，让构件主要承受轴力: Members carrying mostly bending have little capacity: use diagonals to form triangles so members carry axial force
在桥面下方用支柱或上方用钢索/吊杆增加支点，缩短受弯跨度: Add supports with columns below the deck or cables / hangers above it to shorten the bending span
重型货车需要更密的桥面支点: Heavy trucks need more closely spaced deck supports
冲刷区里的桥墩改用桩基础，或把桥墩移到岩石区: Use pile foundations for piers in the scour zone, or move the piers to rock
洪水关卡不要用木桥墩: Don't use timber piers in flood levels
也可以加大跨径，避免在冲刷区建墩: You can also use longer spans and avoid building piers in the scour zone
航道上方（虚线标出的区域）不要放置低于船高的构件: Don't place members lower than the ship height above the channel (the dashed area)
可以用液压杆做可开启的结构：船只到来时液压杆会自动收缩，船过后恢复: You can use hydraulics to build an opening structure: they retract automatically when a ship arrives and return after it passes
利用更多锚点分散支反力: Use more anchors to spread the reactions
单段桥面不能超过材料最大长度: A single deck segment cannot exceed the material's max length
提高结构刚度：加高桁架、改用钢材: Make the structure stiffer: taller truss, steel materials
增加支撑以减小跨度: Add supports to shorten the span
每个节点至少需要两根不共线的构件支撑: Every node needs at least two non-collinear members supporting it
用三角形单元组成桁架，避免四边形机构: Build trusses from triangles; avoid four-sided mechanisms
桥面节点需要桁架或钢索支撑，不能只靠桥面串联: Deck nodes need truss or cable support; a chain of deck segments alone is not enough
保证车辆经过的桥面完整且坡度不过大: Keep the deck under the vehicles complete and not too steep
铁路桥要很刚：加高桁架、缩短桥面支点间距，减小列车经过时的下沉和起伏: Rail bridges must be very stiff: make the truss taller and space the deck supports closer to reduce sag and bounce as the train passes
用更刚的桥面（钢铁轨桥面）或在桥面下加支柱 / 桥墩: Use a stiffer deck (steel rail deck) or add columns / piers under the deck
火车只能走铁轨桥面或铁轨公路复合桥面: Trains can only use the rail deck or the rail + road deck
汽车只能走公路桥面或铁轨公路复合桥面；两种都要过时用复合桥面: Cars can only use the road deck or the rail + road deck; use the rail + road deck when both must cross
增加冗余构件，避免单根构件破坏引起连锁失效: Add redundant members so one failed member does not start a chain reaction
删除不必要的构件，或换用便宜材料: Remove unnecessary members or use cheaper materials
请选择至少一根通用联动驱动杆: Select at least one general linkage drive
通用连杆组件暂不支持钢索或立柱；请将驱动组件与这些构件分开: General linkages do not support cables or columns yet; keep the drive assembly separate from those members
联动组件没有可动自由度，或超过 80 个自由节点的求解规模: The linkage has no movable degree of freedom, or exceeds the solver size of 80 free nodes
所选液压杆没有可实现的行程；请检查固定支撑或零行程设置: The selected hydraulics have no achievable stroke; check the fixed supports or zero-stroke settings
主桥叶构件已断裂，联合机构停止；请修复从动结构: A main leaf member broke and the linkage stopped; repair the driven structure
刚性原构件已断裂，无法继续驱动；请修复从动结构: A rigid original member broke and can no longer be driven; repair the driven structure
几何死点：当前姿态使约束方向退化；请调整高亮位置的初始夹角或支点。: Geometric dead point: the current pose makes the constraint directions degenerate; adjust the initial angle or support at the highlighted position.
约束冲突：所选行程与高亮杆件或刚性连接无法同时满足；已保留上一稳定位置。涉及：: Constraint conflict: the selected stroke cannot be met together with the highlighted members or rigid joints; the last stable position is kept. Involves:
几何死点：三角形接近共线死点；已保留上一稳定位置，请调整支点或初始夹角: Geometric dead point: a triangle is close to collinear; the last stable position is kept, adjust the supports or initial angle
联动机构接近运动奇异点，已保留上一稳定位置: The linkage is close to a singular point; the last stable position is kept
当前在编辑器“游戏”标签内嵌运行：显示模式和窗口大小由编辑器控制，切换不会生效。: Running embedded in the editor's “Game” tab: the editor controls the display mode and window size, so these changes have no effect. Turn off “Embed game” in the Game tab, or run an exported build
全屏 / 无边框：分辨率决定 3D 画面精度，界面始终清晰: Fullscreen / borderless: resolution sets the 3D detail; the interface always stays sharp
承载对比（单段最长、整车压在跨中）: Capacity comparison (longest single span, whole vehicle at mid-span)
在设置中勾选“显示数值”可查看具体数字: Tick “Show values” in the settings to see exact numbers
桥梁实时负载：最大构件利用率，越红越接近承载极限: Live bridge load: highest member utilization; the redder, the closer to the limit
正交侧视（F1），适合建造: Orthographic side view (F1), good for building

，按桥叶开启角自动换算: , converted from the leaf opening angle

入门 · 找断点、补支撑: Beginner · find the weak spot, add support
学会找出断点并补上支撑。: Learn to find where the bridge breaks and add support.
这座桥只铺了桥面。先点「开始测试」试车，看看哪里会断，再补上支撑。: This bridge has only a deck. Click “Start test” first to see where it breaks, then add support.
思路：桥面中间的节点需要支撑。从上方用钢梁组成三角形（桁架），或从下方锚点斜撑到: Idea: the nodes in the middle of the deck need support. Form triangles (a truss) with steel beams from above, or brace from the lower anchors up to the deck nodes.
林区里普通木材充足，但大型胶合木梁只有 2 根。一队行人和一辆巡林车要过河。: Ordinary timber is plentiful in the forest, but there are only 2 large glulam beams. A group of walkers and a ranger vehicle need to cross.
思路：用便宜的木桥面和木梁搭一座矮桁架就够了；胶合木梁更长更强，留给最需要的那一: Idea: a low truss of cheap timber deck and timber beams is enough; glulam beams are longer and stronger, save them for the span that needs them most.
先过轿车，再过重型货车：同一座桥在两种荷载下受力差别很大。: First a car, then a heavy truck: the same bridge carries very different forces under the two loads.
思路：货车很重，桥面支点要更密（约 3 m 一个），再用较高的钢桁架把载荷传到两: Idea: the truck is heavy, so the deck supports must be closer (about one every 3 m); then carry the load to the banks with a taller steel truss. The lower anchors can brace both deck ends.
右岸比左岸高 2 m。桥面坡度不能超过 15%（半透明扇形标出了可行范围），安排: The right bank is 2 m higher than the left. The deck grade cannot exceed 15% (the translucent fan shows the allowed range); plan the deck line.
思路：让桥面从左岸到右岸匀速爬坡（约 10%），桁架跟着桥面一起倾斜，下方锚点斜: Idea: let the deck climb evenly from the left bank to the right (about 10%), tilt the truss with the deck, and brace both ends from the lower anchors.
右岸只有一个锚点，河中有一座岩墩。观察可用支点：上部桁架、岩墩支撑都能过关。: The right bank has only one anchor, and there is a rock pier in the river. Look at the available supports: an upper truss or a rock-pier support both work.
思路：30 m 太长，单靠两岸很吃力。从岩墩锚点 P1 竖起一根支撑顶住桥面中点: Idea: 30 m is too long to rely on the banks alone. Raise a support from rock-pier anchor P1 to hold the middle of the deck, turning one span into two; a reinforced concrete column also works.
60 吨坦克的重量集中在很短的履带上：桥面支点要密、桥面要强，再用岩墩分担跨中。: A 60-ton tank puts its weight on very short tracks: the deck supports must be close, the deck must be strong, and the rock pier should help at mid-span.
思路：用 2 m 一段的钢桥面承受集中荷载；岩墩 P1 上立钢筋混凝土柱顶住跨中: Idea: use steel deck in 2 m segments for the concentrated load; stand a reinforced concrete column on rock pier P1 to hold mid-span, and brace both ends from the lower anchors.
高 9 m 的货船（船顶高出桥面 3 m）要从桥下通过，河道是禁止建墩区：只能利: A 9 m tall cargo ship (its top is 3 m above the deck) must pass under the bridge, and the river is a no-pier zone: only the banks can be used. The orange box is the ship's outline; nothing may be inside it when the ship passes — a fixed deck blocks the channel, so it must be a bascule bridge.
思路：双叶开启桥。每片桥叶在岸边有一个转轴节点（只有这一个节点连着岸上结构），液: Idea: a double-leaf bascule bridge. Each leaf has one pivot node at the bank (the only node connected to the shore structure); each hydraulic has one end on the shore and one on the leaf. Set the center deck joint as the “center lock” and set the hydraulics to drive the leaves. When the ship comes, vehicles stop, the lock opens and the leaves rise; after the ship passes they close and lock before traffic resumes. The hydraulic stroke is only ±25%, so a short lever arm cannot push the leaf.
60 m 长、160 吨的货运列车会把整座桥压满很长时间，桥要经得起持续的满载。: A 60 m long, 160-ton freight train loads the whole bridge for a long time, so the bridge must take a sustained full load. The train only runs on rails and the trucks behind it only on road, so use the rail + road deck; if the rails move too much the train derails.
思路：列车荷载像一条很重的均布荷载。用桁架加岩墩支撑把 30 m 分成两跨；预应: Idea: the train load acts like a very heavy uniform load. Split the 30 m into two spans with a truss and a rock-pier support; a prestressed box girder reaches 28 m in one piece and makes long chords with fewer nodes.
两岸是立交：下层和上层道路都要通车。上层桥面可以兼作桁架的上弦。: Both banks are interchanges: the lower and upper roads both carry traffic. The upper deck can double as the truss's top chord.
思路：下层桥面做下弦、上层桥面做上弦，中间用钢竖杆和斜杆连成一座双层桁架。: Idea: use the lower deck as the bottom chord and the upper deck as the top chord, linked by steel verticals and diagonals into a two-level truss.
这座锈蚀的老钢桁架桥只按轿车设计。现在要让重型货车通过：旧构件不花钱，但承载力已: This rusty old steel truss bridge was designed only for cars. Now heavy trucks must cross: old members are free, but their capacity is reduced, and at most 4 can be removed.
先试车：轿车能过，货车会压坏锈蚀的钢梁。选中旧构件可以“修复”，也可以拆除（最多: Test first: the car gets across, but the truck crushes the rusty steel beams. Select old members to “repair” them, remove them (at most 4) or add new supports.
思路：单靠一种手段不够。修复锈蚀最严重的桁架杆件，再从下方锚点加两根钢斜撑分担两: Idea: one measure alone is not enough. Repair the most rusted truss members, then add two steel braces from the lower anchors to share the end loads. You can also replace part of the heavy deck to reduce self-weight.
40 m 宽的河，左侧河床是岩石、右侧是软土。一支车队（空载厢车、货车、满载重卡: A 40 m wide river: rock on the left riverbed, soft soil on the right. A convoy (empty van, truck, fully loaded heavy truck) crosses one after another. Split the long span with piers.
思路：用桥墩工具在河床上立墩，点在桥面节点上可让墩顶直接顶住桥面。岩石上浅基础就: Idea: raise piers on the riverbed with the pier tool; clicking a deck node lets the pier top push directly on the deck. Shallow foundations are enough on rock; on soft soil they carry little, so switch to pile foundations (select the pier base node to switch).
测试开始后会来一场洪水：水位上涨，河中央的软土冲刷区会被掏空。洪水过后，重型货车: A flood comes after the test starts: the water rises and the soft-soil scour zone in the middle of the river gets hollowed out. After the flood, a heavy truck must cross.
思路：木桥墩会被洪水冲毁；冲刷区里的浅基础会被掏空。把混凝土桥墩建在两侧岩石区，: Idea: timber piers are destroyed by the flood; shallow foundations in the scour zone get scoured out. Build concrete piers on the rock on both sides, or use pile foundations in the scour zone, or use longer spans and build no piers in the scour zone.

工字钢截面：抗拉压强、不易屈曲（屈曲承载力约为原来 2.4 倍：6 m 以内可承: I-section steel: strong in tension and compression and resists buckling (about 2.4× the buckling capacity: 420 kN in compression up to 6 m, about 240 kN at 10 m); good for truss chords and compression braces
只能受拉，适合悬挂与斜拉结构: Tension only; good for suspended and cable-stayed structures
多股复合钢索：比钢索更贵、更长、更粗、更重，拉力约 2.7 倍；只能受拉，自重下: Multi-strand composite cable: more expensive, longer, thicker and heavier than a steel cable, with about 2.7× the tensile force; tension only, and sags slightly under its own weight
两端铰接，强度略低于钢材；行程固定为初始长度的 50%；只需选择收缩或伸展，船过: Pinned at both ends, slightly weaker than steel; stroke fixed at 50% of the initial length; just choose retract or extend, and it returns to its initial length after the ship passes
很重、抗拉压强、不怕风；底端必须在陆地上并形成固定基础；倾角不得超过 15°: Very heavy, strong in tension and compression, unaffected by wind; the bottom must be on land and form a fixed foundation; tilt at most 15°
比混凝土柱更重更强，比钢材贵；只能建在地图锚点上并形成刚接基础；倾角不得超过 3: Heavier and stronger than a concrete column, more expensive than steel; can only be built on map anchors and forms a rigid foundation; tilt at most 30°
最便宜、轻巧：单段 3 m 跨中可承载约 6 吨，只适合轿车和行人: Cheapest and light: a 3 m segment carries about 6 t at mid-span, only for cars and walkers
最强最贵：单段 6 m 跨中可承载约 70 吨，能过 60 吨坦克；重量只有混凝: Strongest and most expensive: a 6 m segment carries about 70 t at mid-span, enough for the 60-ton tank; half the weight of a concrete deck
便宜耐用：单段 5 m 跨中可承载约 40 吨，能过重型货车；但很重（600 k: Cheap and durable: a 5 m segment carries about 40 t at mid-span, enough for heavy trucks; but very heavy (600 kg/m), shows crack warnings above 60% utilization
钢桥面上铺两条钢轨：只有火车能通行，汽车不能上；刚度和强度略高于钢桥面: Two steel rails on a steel deck: trains only, cars cannot use it; slightly stiffer and stronger than the steel deck
混凝土路面里嵌入钢轨：火车和汽车都能通行；比普通混凝土桥面贵很多，利用率超过 6: Steel rails embedded in a concrete road: both trains and cars can use it; much more expensive than a normal concrete deck, cracks above 60% utilization
多层木材胶合而成：比普通木梁更大更长（最长 14 m），轻且强；运输长度大、费用: Laminated from layers of timber: larger and longer than a timber beam (up to 14 m), light and strong; long to transport and costly, limited in some levels
预制实心梁，适合短跨小桥；自重很大（375 kg/m），利用率超过 60% 会出: Precast solid beam for short small bridges; very heavy (375 kg/m), cracks above 60% utilization and only fails under more load
预制预应力梁：张拉钢筋预先施加压力，放置后略微上拱，加载后逐渐趋平；可一跨 20: Precast prestressed girder: tensioned steel pre-compresses it, so it arches slightly when placed and flattens under load; spans 20 m, good for rivers where piers are not allowed
预制预应力箱梁：比 I 形梁更强更刚、更重更贵，单跨可达 28 m: Precast prestressed box girder: stronger, stiffer, heavier and more expensive than the I-girder, spans up to 28 m
玻璃纤维复合材料：很轻（95 kg/m）、耐腐蚀、价格高；刚度低，注意桥面挠度限: Glass-fiber composite: very light (95 kg/m), corrosion resistant, expensive; low stiffness, mind the deck deflection limit. Good for re-decking old bridges
从河床立起，自带中部和顶部两个支点；比混凝土墩便宜，但怕洪水（洪水时会被冲毁）: Rises from the riverbed with a middle and a top support; cheaper than a concrete pier, but floods destroy it
